withdrawnCandidateReason: The old unsigned candidate incorrectly placed the orange provider at title65 before direct inspection of its newly extracted full frame. That frame is black; direct inspection rejects65 and selects the first visible fruit-stall card66. The old candidate was never installed or sent for signing.
supersededCandidateReason: V2 was rejected before install because five inherited frameSha256 values identified an earlier PNG encoding, while its file/sha256 identified the current same-pixel encoding. The old encoded hashes were independently reproduced from the verified original video/time, and the current images were directly viewed again. V3 binds immutable current copies with consistent hashes and retains all prior observation hashes/provenance.
